verdicts.reason: Quote says 'should be set', so strength is SHOULD, not MUST.
Advisory caution to the integrator about unbuffered prescale; nothing concrete to verify.
Defines the meaning of tvalid (data is valid); a definition, not a checkable constraint.
'Accept only when tready is high' is a restriction (MUST_NOT) and is checkable every cycle from interface signals.
'Only when both high' restricts transfer: no transfer unless tvalid and tready are both high. It is a bus-level property, not specific to the source.
Busy high during an operation is stated for both interfaces and is checkable.
Overrun behavior is stated explicitly: single-cycle pulse and discard.
Frame error behavior is stated explicitly: single pulse and discard.
Tool prerequisite, not a design behavior to verify.
Describes ways to run testbenches, not a design behavior to verify.

questions.question: On overrun, is the newly received word discarded while the older word in the tdata register is retained? What exactly defines the busy window on the receiver (start bit to stop bit)?
